He was sitting on a bench before the fire, with his feet on","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"the stove hearth, and in one hand was holding close up to his face","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"that little negro idol of his; peering hard into its face, and with a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"jack-knife gently whittling away at its nose, meanwhile humming to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"himself in his heathenish way.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"But being now interrupted, he put up the image; and pretty soon,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"going to the table, took up a large book there, and placing it on his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"lap began counting the pages with deliberate regularity; at every","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"fiftieth page--as I fancied--stopping a moment, looking vacantly","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"around him, and giving utterance to a long-drawn gurgling whistle of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"astonishment.  He would then begin again at the next fifty; seeming","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"to commence at number one each time, as though he could not count","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"more than fifty, and it was only by such a large number of fifties","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"being found together, that his astonishment at the multitude of pages","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"was excited.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"With much interest I sat watching him.  Savage though he was, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"hideously marred about the face--at least to my taste--his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"countenance yet had a something in it which was by no means","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"disagreeable.  You cannot hide the soul.  Through all his unearthly","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"tattooings, I thought I saw the traces of a simple honest heart; and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"in his large, deep eyes, fiery black and bold, there seemed tokens of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"a spirit that would dare a thousand devils.  And besides all this,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"there was a certain lofty bearing about the Pagan, which even his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"uncouthness could not altogether maim.  He looked like a man who had","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"never cringed and never had had a creditor.  Whether it was, too,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"that his head being shaved, his forehead was drawn out in freer and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"brighter relief, and looked more expansive than it otherwise would,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"this I will not venture to decide; but certain it was his head was","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"phrenologically an excellent one.  It may seem ridiculous, but it","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"reminded me of General Washington's head, as seen in the popular","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"busts of him.  It had the same long regularly graded retreating slope","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"from above the brows, which were likewise very projecting, like two","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"long promontories thickly wooded on top.  Queequeg was George","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Washington cannibalistically developed.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Whilst I was thus closely scanning him, half-pretending meanwhile to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"be looking out at the storm from the casement, he never heeded my","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"presence, never troubled himself with so much as a single glance; but","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"appeared wholly occupied with counting the pages of the marvellous","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"book.  Considering how sociably we had been sleeping together the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"night previous, and especially considering the affectionate arm I had","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"found thrown over me upon waking in the morning, I thought this","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"indifference of his very strange.  But savages are strange beings; at","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"times you do not know exactly how to take them.  At first they are","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"overawing; their calm self-collectedness of simplicity seems a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Socratic wisdom.  I had noticed also that Queequeg never consorted at","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"all, or but very little, with the other seamen in the inn.  He made","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"no advances whatever; appeared to have no desire to enlarge the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"circle of his acquaintances.  All this struck me as mighty singular;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"yet, upon second thoughts, there was something almost sublime in it.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Here was a man some twenty thousand miles from home, by the way of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Cape Horn, that is--which was the only way he could get there--thrown","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"among people as strange to him as though he were in the planet","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Jupiter; and yet he seemed entirely at his ease; preserving the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"utmost serenity; content with his own companionship; always equal to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"himself.  Surely this was a touch of fine philosophy; though no doubt","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"he had never heard there was such a thing as that.  But, perhaps, to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"be true philosophers, we mortals should not be conscious of so living","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"or so striving.  So soon as I hear that such or such a man gives","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"himself out for a philosopher, I conclude that, like the dyspeptic","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"old woman, he must have \"broken his digester.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"As I sat there in that now lonely room; the fire burning low, in that","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"mild stage when, after its first intensity has warmed the air, it","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"then only glows to be looked at; the evening shades and phantoms","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"gathering round the casements, and peering in upon us silent,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"solitary twain; the storm booming without in solemn swells; I began","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"to be sensible of strange feelings.  I felt a melting in me.  No more","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"my splintered heart and maddened hand were turned against the wolfish","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"world.  This soothing savage had redeemed it.  There he sat, his very","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"indifference speaking a nature in which there lurked no civilized","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"hypocrisies and bland deceits.  Wild he was; a very sight of sights","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"to see; yet I began to feel myself mysteriously drawn towards him.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"And those same things that would have repelled most others, they were","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"the very magnets that thus drew me.  I'll try a pagan friend, thought","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"I, since Christian kindness has proved but hollow courtesy.  I drew","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"my bench near him, and made some friendly signs and hints, doing my","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"best to talk with him meanwhile.  At first he little noticed these","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"advances; but presently, upon my referring to his last night's","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"hospitalities, he made out to ask me whether we were again to be","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"bedfellows.  I told him yes; whereat I thought he looked pleased,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"perhaps a little complimented.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"We then turned over the book together, and I endeavored to explain to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"him the purpose of the printing, and the meaning of the few pictures","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"that were in it.  Thus I soon engaged his interest; and from that we","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"went to jabbering the best we could about the various outer sights to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"be seen in this famous town.  Soon I proposed a social smoke; and,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"producing his pouch and tomahawk, he quietly offered me a puff.  And","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"then we sat exchanging puffs from that wild pipe of his, and keeping","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"it regularly passing between us.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"If there yet lurked any ice of indifference towards me in the Pagan's","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"breast, this pleasant, genial smoke we had, soon thawed it out, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"left us cronies.  He seemed to take to me quite as naturally and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"unbiddenly as I to him; and when our smoke was over, he pressed his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"forehead against mine, clasped me round the waist, and said that","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"henceforth we were married; meaning, in his country's phrase, that we","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"were bosom friends; he would gladly die for me, if need should be.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"In a countryman, this sudden flame of friendship would have seemed","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"far too premature, a thing to be much distrusted; but in this simple","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"savage those old rules would not apply.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"After supper, and another social chat and smoke, we went to our room","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"together.  He made me a present of his embalmed head; took out his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"enormous tobacco wallet, and groping under the tobacco, drew out some","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"thirty dollars in silver; then spreading them on the table, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"mechanically dividing them into two equal portions, pushed one of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"them towards me, and said it was mine.  I was going to remonstrate;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"but he silenced me by pouring them into my trowsers' pockets.  I let","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"them stay.  He then went about his evening prayers, took out his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"idol, and removed the paper fireboard.  By certain signs and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"symptoms, I thought he seemed anxious for me to join him; but well","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"knowing what was to follow, I deliberated a moment whether, in case","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"he invited me, I would comply or otherwise.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"I was a good Christian; born and bred in the bosom of the infallible","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Presbyterian Church.  How then could I unite with this wild idolator","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"in worshipping his piece of wood?  But what is worship? thought I.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Do you suppose now, Ishmael, that the magnanimous God of heaven and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"earth--pagans and all included--can possibly be jealous of an","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"insignificant bit of black wood?  Impossible!  But what is","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"}]}

and the bottom of which was formed of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"a stout interlacing of the same elastic stuff of which the wigwam was","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"constructed.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"There was nothing so very particular, perhaps, about the appearance","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"of the elderly man I saw; he was brown and brawny, like most old","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"seamen, and heavily rolled up in blue pilot-cloth, cut in the Quaker","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"style; only there was a fine and almost microscopic net-work of the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"minutest wrinkles interlacing round his eyes, which must have arisen","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"from his continual sailings in many hard gales, and always looking to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"windward;--for this causes the muscles about the eyes to become","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"pursed together.  Such eye-wrinkles are very effectual in a scowl.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Is this the Captain of the Pequod?\" said I, advancing to the door of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"the tent.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Supposing it be the captain of the Pequod, what dost thou want of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"him?\" he demanded.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"I was thinking of shipping.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Thou wast, wast thou?  I see thou art no Nantucketer--ever been in","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"a stove boat?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"No, Sir, I never have.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Dost know nothing at all about whaling, I dare say--eh?","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Nothing, Sir; but I have no doubt I shall soon learn.  I've been","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"several voyages in the merchant service, and I think that--\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Merchant service be damned.  Talk not that lingo to me.  Dost see","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"that leg?--I'll take that leg away from thy stern, if ever thou","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"talkest of the marchant service to me again.  Marchant service","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"indeed!  I suppose now ye feel considerable proud of having served in","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"those marchant ships.  But flukes! man, what makes thee want to go a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"whaling, eh?--it looks a little suspicious, don't it, eh?--Hast not","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"been a pirate, hast thou?--Didst not rob thy last Captain, didst","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"thou?--Dost not think of murdering the officers when thou gettest to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"sea?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"I protested my innocence of these things.  I saw that under the mask","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"of these half humorous innuendoes, this old seaman, as an insulated","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Quakerish Nantucketer, was full of his insular prejudices, and rather","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"distrustful of all aliens, unless they hailed from Cape Cod or the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Vineyard.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"But what takes thee a-whaling?  I want to know that before I think","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"of shipping ye.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Well, sir, I want to see what whaling is.  I want to see the world.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Want to see what whaling is, eh?  Have ye clapped eye on Captain","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Ahab?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Who is Captain Ahab, sir?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Aye, aye, I thought so.  Captain Ahab is the Captain of this ship.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"I am mistaken then.  I thought I was speaking to the Captain","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"himself.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Thou art speaking to Captain Peleg--that's who ye are speaking to,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"young man.  It belongs to me and Captain Bildad to see the Pequod","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"fitted out for the voyage, and supplied with all her needs, including","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"crew.  We are part owners and agents.  But as I was going to say, if","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"thou wantest to know what whaling is, as thou tellest ye do, I can","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"put ye in a way of finding it out before ye bind yourself to it, past","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"backing out.  Clap eye on Captain Ahab, young man, and thou wilt find","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"that he has only one leg.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"What do you mean, sir?  Was the other one lost by a whale?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Lost by a whale!  Young man, come nearer to me: it was devoured,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"chewed up, crunched by the monstrousest parmacetty that ever chipped","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"a boat!--ah, ah!\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"I was a little alarmed by his energy, perhaps also a little touched","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"at the hearty grief in his concluding exclamation, but said as calmly","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"as I could, \"What you say is no doubt true enough, sir; but how could","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"I know there was any peculiar ferocity in that particular whale,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"though indeed I might have inferred as much from the simple fact of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"the accident.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Look ye now, young man, thy lungs are a sort of soft, d'ye see; thou","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"dost not talk shark a bit.  SURE, ye've been to sea before now; sure","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"of that?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Sir,\" said I, \"I thought I told you that I had been four voyages in","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"the merchant--\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Hard down out of that!  Mind what I said about the marchant","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"service--don't aggravate me--I won't have it.  But let us understand","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"each other.  I have given thee a hint about what whaling is; do ye","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"yet feel inclined for it?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"I do, sir.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Very good.  Now, art thou the man to pitch a harpoon down a live","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"whale's throat, and then jump after it?  Answer, quick!\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"I am, sir, if it should be positively indispensable to do so; not to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"be got rid of, that is; which I don't take to be the fact.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Good again.  Now then, thou not only wantest to go a-whaling, to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"find out by experience what whaling is, but ye also want to go in","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"order to see the world?  Was not that what ye said?  I thought so.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Well then, just step forward there, and take a peep over the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"weather-bow, and then back to me and tell me what ye see there.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"For a moment I stood a little puzzled by this curious request, not","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"knowing exactly how to take it, whether humorously or in earnest.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"But concentrating all his crow's feet into one scowl, Captain Peleg","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"started me on the errand.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Going forward and glancing over the weather bow, I perceived that the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"ship swinging to her anchor with the flood-tide, was now obliquely","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"pointing towards the open ocean.  The prospect was unlimited, but","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"exceedingly monotonous and forbidding; not the slightest variety that","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"I could see.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Well, what's the report?\" said Peleg when I came back; \"what did ye","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"see?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Not much,\" I replied--\"nothing but water; considerable horizon","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"though, and there's a squall coming up, I think.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Well, what does thou think then of seeing the world?  Do ye wish to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"go round Cape Horn to see any more of it, eh?  Can't ye see the world","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"where you stand?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"I was a little staggered, but go a-whaling I must, and I would; and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"the Pequod was as good a ship as any--I thought the best--and all","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"this I now repeated to Peleg. It turned out to be Captain Bildad, who along","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"with Captain Peleg was one of the largest owners of the vessel; the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"other shares, as is sometimes the case in these ports, being held by","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"a crowd of old annuitants; widows, fatherless children, and chancery","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"wards; each owning about the value of a timber head, or a foot of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"plank, or a nail or two in the ship.  People in Nantucket invest","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"their money in whaling vessels, the same way that you do yours in","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"approved state stocks bringing in good interest.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Now, Bildad, like Peleg, and indeed many other Nantucketers, was a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Quaker, the island having been originally settled by that sect; and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"to this day its inhabitants in general retain in an uncommon measure","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"the peculiarities of the Quaker, only variously and anomalously","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"modified by things altogether alien and heterogeneous.  For some of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"these same Quakers are the most sanguinary of all sailors and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"whale-hunters.  They are fighting Quakers; they are Quakers with a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"vengeance.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"So that there are instances among them of men, who, named with","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Scripture names--a singularly common fashion on the island--and in","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"childhood naturally imbibing the stately dramatic thee and thou of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"the Quaker idiom; still, from the audacious, daring, and boundless","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"adventure of their subsequent lives, strangely blend with these","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"unoutgrown peculiarities, a thousand bold dashes of character, not","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"unworthy a Scandinavian sea-king, or a poetical Pagan Roman.  And","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"when these things unite in a man of greatly superior natural force,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"with a globular brain and a ponderous heart; who has also by the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"stillness and seclusion of many long night-watches in the remotest","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"waters, and beneath constellations never seen here at the north, been","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"led to think untraditionally and independently; receiving all","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"nature's sweet or savage impressions fresh from her own virgin","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"voluntary and confiding breast, and thereby chiefly, but with some","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"help from accidental advantages, to learn a bold and nervous lofty","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"language--that man makes one in a whole nation's census--a mighty","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"pageant creature, formed for noble tragedies.  Nor will it at all","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"detract from him, dramatically regarded, if either by birth or other","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"circumstances, he have what seems a half wilful overruling morbidness","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"at the bottom of his nature.  For all men tragically great are made","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"so through a certain morbidness.  Be sure of this, O young ambition,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"all mortal greatness is but disease.  But, as yet we have not to do","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"with such an one, but with quite another; and still a man, who, if","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"indeed peculiar, it only results again from another phase of the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Quaker, modified by individual circumstances.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Like Captain Peleg, Captain Bildad was a well-to-do, retired","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"whaleman.  But unlike Captain Peleg--who cared not a rush for what","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"are called serious things, and indeed deemed those self-same serious","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"things the veriest of all trifles--Captain Bildad had not only been","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"originally educated according to the strictest sect of Nantucket","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Quakerism, but all his subsequent ocean life, and the sight of many","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"unclad, lovely island creatures, round the Horn--all that had not","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"moved this native born Quaker one single jot, had not so much as","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"altered one angle of his vest.  Still, for all this immutableness,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"was there some lack of common consistency about worthy Captain","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Peleg.  Though refusing, from conscientious scruples, to bear arms","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"against land invaders, yet himself had illimitably invaded the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Atlantic and Pacific; and though a sworn foe to human bloodshed, yet","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"had he in his straight-bodied coat, spilled tuns upon tuns of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"leviathan gore.  How now in the contemplative evening of his days,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"the pious Bildad reconciled these things in the reminiscence, I do","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"not know; but it did not seem to concern him much, and very probably","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"he had long since come to the sage and sensible conclusion that a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"man's religion is one thing, and this practical world quite another.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"This world pays dividends.  Rising from a little cabin-boy in short","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"clothes of the drabbest drab, to a harpooneer in a broad shad-bellied","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"waistcoat; from that becoming boat-header, chief-mate, and captain,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"and finally a ship owner; Bildad, as I hinted before, had concluded","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"his adventurous career by wholly retiring from active life at the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"goodly age of sixty, and dedicating his remaining days to the quiet","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"receiving of his well-earned income.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Now, Bildad, I am sorry to say, had the reputation of being an","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"incorrigible old hunks, and in his sea-going days, a bitter, hard","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"task-master.  They told me in Nantucket, though it certainly seems a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"curious story, that when he sailed the old Categut whaleman, his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"crew, upon arriving home, were mostly all carried ashore to the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"hospital, sore exhausted and worn out.  For a pious man, especially","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"for a Quaker, he was certainly rather hard-hearted, to say the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"least.  He never used to swear, though, at his men, they said; but","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"somehow he got an inordinate quantity of cruel, unmitigated hard work","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"out of them.  When Bildad was a chief-mate, to have his drab-coloured","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"eye intently looking at you, made you feel completely nervous, till","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"you could clutch something--a hammer or a marling-spike, and go to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"work like mad, at something or other, never mind what.  Indolence and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"idleness perished before him.  His own person was the exact","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"embodiment of his utilitarian character.  On his long, gaunt body, he","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"carried no spare flesh, no superfluous beard, his chin having a soft,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"economical nap to it, like the worn nap of his broad-brimmed hat.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Such, then, was the person that I saw seated on the transom when I","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"followed Captain Peleg down into the cabin.  The space between the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"decks was small; and there, bolt-upright, sat old Bildad, who always","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"sat so, and never leaned, and this to save his coat tails.  His","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"broad-brim was placed beside him; his legs were stiffly crossed; his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"drab vesture was buttoned up to his chin; and spectacles on nose, he","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"seemed absorbed in reading from a ponderous volume.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Bildad,\" cried Captain Peleg, \"at it again, Bildad, eh? Bildad?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"As Peleg.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"He After sitting a long time listening to the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"long stories of some sailors who had just come from a plum-pudding","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"voyage, as they called it (that is, a short whaling-voyage in a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"schooner or brig, confined to the north of the line, in the Atlantic","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Ocean only); after listening to these plum-puddingers till nearly","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"eleven o'clock, I went up stairs to go to bed, feeling quite sure by","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"this time Queequeg must certainly have brought his Ramadan to a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"termination. this fellow has broken loose from","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"somewhere; he's talking about something and somebody we don't know.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Stop!\" cried the stranger.  \"Ye said true--ye hav'n't seen Old","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Thunder yet, have ye?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Who's Old Thunder?\" said I, again riveted with the insane","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"earnestness of his manner.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"}]}
