response.body: {"id":"7","offset":"499559","completed":false,"execCompleted":true,"hasFailedNodes":false,"execState":"succeeded","lastModified":"1589248294000","execDuration":23000,"percentLoaded":19.528143200415613,"totalSize":2558149,"retryBackoff":0,"clusterExec":true,"compacted":false,"entries":[{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Captain Ahab.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"What! the captain of our ship, the Pequod?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Aye, among some of us old sailor chaps, he goes by that name.  Ye","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"hav'n't seen him yet, have ye?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"No, we hav'n't.  He's sick they say, but is getting better, and will","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"be all right again before long.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"All right again before long!\" laughed the stranger, with a solemnly","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"derisive sort of laugh.  \"Look ye; when Captain Ahab is all right,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"then this left arm of mine will be all right; not before.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"What do you know about him?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"What did they TELL you about him?  Say that!\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"They didn't tell much of anything about him; only I've heard that","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"he's a good whale-hunter, and a good captain to his crew.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"That's true, that's true--yes, both true enough.  But you must jump","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"when he gives an order.  Step and growl; growl and go--that's the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"word with Captain Ahab.  But nothing about that thing that happened","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"to him off Cape Horn, long ago, when he lay like dead for three days","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"and nights; nothing about that deadly skrimmage with the Spaniard","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"afore the altar in Santa?--heard nothing about that, eh?  Nothing","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"about the silver calabash he spat into?  And nothing about his losing","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"his leg last voyage, according to the prophecy.  Didn't ye hear a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"word about them matters and something more, eh?  No, I don't think ye","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"did; how could ye?  Who knows it?  Not all Nantucket, I guess.  But","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"hows'ever, mayhap, ye've heard tell about the leg, and how he lost","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"it; aye, ye have heard of that, I dare say.  Oh yes, THAT every one","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"knows a'most--I mean they know he's only one leg; and that a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"parmacetti took the other off.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"My friend,\" said I, \"what all this gibberish of yours is about, I","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"don't know, and I don't much care; for it seems to me that you must","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"be a little damaged in the head.  But if you are speaking of Captain","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Ahab, of that ship there, the Pequod, then let me tell you, that I","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"know all about the loss of his leg.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"ALL about it, eh--sure you do?--all?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Pretty sure.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"With finger pointed and eye levelled at the Pequod, the beggar-like","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"stranger stood a moment, as if in a troubled reverie; then starting a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"little, turned and said:--\"Ye've shipped, have ye?  Names down on the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"papers?  Well, well, what's signed, is signed; and what's to be, will","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"be; and then again, perhaps it won't be, after all.  Anyhow, it's","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"all fixed and arranged a'ready; and some sailors or other must go","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"with him, I suppose; as well these as any other men, God pity 'em!","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Morning to ye, shipmates, morning; the ineffable heavens bless ye;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"I'm sorry I stopped ye.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Look here, friend,\" said I, \"if you have anything important to tell","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"us, out with it; but if you are only trying to bamboozle us, you are","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"mistaken in your game; that's all I have to say.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"And it's said very well, and I like to hear a chap talk up that way;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"you are just the man for him--the likes of ye.  Morning to ye,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"shipmates, morning!  Oh! when ye get there, tell 'em I've concluded","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"not to make one of 'em.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Ah, my dear fellow, you can't fool us that way--you can't fool us.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"It is the easiest thing in the world for a man to look as if he had a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"great secret in him.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Morning to ye, shipmates, morning.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Morning it is,\" said I.  \"Come along, Queequeg, let's leave this","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"crazy man.  But stop, tell me your name, will you?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"\"Elijah.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Elijah! thought I, and we walked away, both commenting, after each","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"other's fashion, upon this ragged old sailor; and agreed that he was","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"nothing but a humbug, trying to be a bugbear.  But we had not gone","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"perhaps above a hundred yards, when chancing to turn a corner, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"looking back as I did so, who should be seen but Elijah following us,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"though at a distance.  Somehow, the sight of him struck me so, that I","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"said nothing to Queequeg of his being behind, but passed on with my","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"comrade, anxious to see whether the stranger would turn the same","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"corner that we did.  He did; and then it seemed to me that he was","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"dogging us, but with what intent I could not for the life of me","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"imagine.  This circumstance, coupled with his ambiguous,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"half-hinting, half-revealing, shrouded sort of talk, now begat in me","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"all kinds of vague wonderments and half-apprehensions, and all","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"connected with the Pequod; and Captain Ahab; and the leg he had lost;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"and the Cape Horn fit; and the silver calabash; and what Captain","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Peleg had said of him, when I left the ship the day previous; and the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"prediction of the squaw Tistig; and the voyage we had bound ourselves","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"to sail; and a hundred other shadowy things.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"I was resolved to satisfy myself whether this ragged Elijah was","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"really dogging us or not, and with that intent crossed the way with","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Queequeg, and on that side of it retraced our steps.  But Elijah","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"passed on, without seeming to notice us.  This relieved me; and once","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"more, and finally as it seemed to me, I pronounced him in my heart, a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"humbug.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"CHAPTER 20","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"All Astir.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"A day or two passed, and there was great activity aboard the Pequod.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"Not only were the old sails being mended, but new sails were coming","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"on board, and bolts of canvas, and coils of rigging; in short,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"everything betokened that the ship's preparations were hurrying to a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"close.  Captain Peleg seldom or never went ashore, but sat in his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"wigwam keeping a sharp look-out upon the hands: Bildad did all the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"purchasing and providing at the stores; and the men employed in the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"hold and on the rigging were working till long after night-fall.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"On the day following Queequeg's signing the articles, word was given","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"at all the inns where the ship's company were stopping, that their","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"chests must be on board before night, for there was no telling how","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:46","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:46Z","log":"soon the vessel might be sailing. Whether he ever thought of it at all,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"might be a question; but, if he ever did chance to cast his mind that","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"way after a comfortable dinner, no doubt, like a good sailor, he took","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"it to be a sort of call of the watch to tumble aloft, and bestir","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"themselves there, about something which he would find out when he","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"obeyed the order, and not sooner.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"What, perhaps, with other things, made Stubb such an easy-going,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"unfearing man, so cheerily trudging off with the burden of life in a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"world full of grave pedlars, all bowed to the ground with their","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"packs; what helped to bring about that almost impious good-humor of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"his; that thing must have been his pipe.  For, like his nose, his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"short, black little pipe was one of the regular features of his face.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"You would almost as soon have expected him to turn out of his bunk","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"without his nose as without his pipe.  He kept a whole row of pipes","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"there ready loaded, stuck in a rack, within easy reach of his hand;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"and, whenever he turned in, he smoked them all out in succession,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"lighting one from the other to the end of the chapter; then loading","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"them again to be in readiness anew.  For, when Stubb dressed, instead","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"of first putting his legs into his trowsers, he put his pipe into his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"mouth.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"I say this continual smoking must have been one cause, at least, of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"his peculiar disposition; for every one knows that this earthly air,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"whether ashore or afloat, is terribly infected with the nameless","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"miseries of the numberless mortals who have died exhaling it; and as","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"in time of the cholera, some people go about with a camphorated","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"handkerchief to their mouths; so, likewise, against all mortal","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"tribulations, Stubb's tobacco smoke might have operated as a sort of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"disinfecting agent.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"The third mate was Flask, a native of Tisbury, in Martha's Vineyard.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"A short, stout, ruddy young fellow, very pugnacious concerning","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"whales, who somehow seemed to think that the great leviathans had","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"personally and hereditarily affronted him; and therefore it was a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"sort of point of honour with him, to destroy them whenever","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"encountered.  So utterly lost was he to all sense of reverence for","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"the many marvels of their majestic bulk and mystic ways; and so dead","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"to anything like an apprehension of any possible danger from","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"encountering them; that in his poor opinion, the wondrous whale was","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"but a species of magnified mouse, or at least water-rat, requiring","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"only a little circumvention and some small application of time and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"trouble in order to kill and boil.  This ignorant, unconscious","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"fearlessness of his made him a little waggish in the matter of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"whales; he followed these fish for the fun of it; and a three years'","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"voyage round Cape Horn was only a jolly joke that lasted that length","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"of time.  As a carpenter's nails are divided into wrought nails and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"cut nails; so mankind may be similarly divided.  Little Flask was one","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"of the wrought ones; made to clinch tight and last long.  They called","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"him King-Post on board of the Pequod; because, in form, he could be","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"well likened to the short, square timber known by that name in Arctic","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"whalers; and which by the means of many radiating side timbers","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"inserted into it, serves to brace the ship against the icy","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"concussions of those battering seas.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"Now these three mates--Starbuck, Stubb, and Flask, were momentous","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"}]}

Black Letter tells me that Sir Martin","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"Frobisher on his return from that voyage, when Queen Bess did","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"gallantly wave her jewelled hand to him from a window of Greenwich","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"Palace, as his bold ship sailed down the Thames; \"when Sir Martin","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"returned from that voyage,\" saith Black Letter, \"on bended knees he","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"presented to her highness a prodigious long horn of the Narwhale,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"which for a long period after hung in the castle at Windsor.\"  An","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"Irish author avers that the Earl of Leicester, on bended knees, did","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"likewise present to her highness another horn, pertaining to a land","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"beast of the unicorn nature.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"The Narwhale has a very picturesque, leopard-like look, being of a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"milk-white ground colour, dotted with round and oblong spots of black.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"His oil is very superior, clear and fine; From what I have seen of him at a distance,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"I should say that he was about the bigness of a grampus. He","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"mounts the Folio whale's back, and as he swims, he works his passage","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"by flogging him; as some schoolmasters get along in the world by a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"similar process. The Mealy-mouthed","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"Porpoise.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"To those who have not chanced specially to study the subject, it may","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"possibly seem strange, that fishes not commonly exceeding four or","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"five feet should be marshalled among WHALES--a word, which, in the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"popular sense, always conveys an idea of hugeness.  But the creatures","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"set down above as Duodecimoes are infallibly whales, by the terms of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"my definition of what a whale is--i.e. a spouting fish, with a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"horizontal tail.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"BOOK III. (HUZZA PORPOISE).--This is the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"common porpoise found almost all over the globe.  The name is of my","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"own bestowal; for there are more than one sort of porpoises, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"something must be done to distinguish them.  I call him thus, because","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"he always swims in hilarious shoals, which upon the broad sea keep","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"tossing themselves to heaven like caps in a Fourth-of-July crowd.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"Their appearance is generally hailed with delight by the mariner.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"Full of fine spirits, they invariably come from the breezy billows to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"windward.  They are the lads that always live before the wind.  They","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"are accounted a lucky omen.  If you yourself can withstand three","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"cheers at beholding these vivacious fish, then heaven help ye; the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"spirit of godly gamesomeness is not in ye.  A well-fed, plump Huzza","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"Porpoise will yield you one good gallon of good oil.  But the fine","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"and delicate fluid extracted from his jaws is exceedingly valuable.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"It is in request among jewellers and watchmakers.  Sailors put it on","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"their hones.  Porpoise meat is good eating, you know.  It may never","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"have occurred to you that a porpoise spouts.  Indeed, his spout is so","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"small that it is not very readily discernible.  But the next time you","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"have a chance, watch him; and you will then see the great Sperm whale","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"himself in miniature.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"BOOK III. (DUODECIMO), CHAPTER III. (MEALY-MOUTHED PORPOISE).--The","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"largest kind of Porpoise; and only found in the Pacific, so far as it","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"is known.  The only English name, by which he has hitherto been","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"designated, is that of the fishers--Right-Whale Porpoise, from the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"circumstance that he is chiefly found in the vicinity of that Folio.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"In shape, he differs in some degree from the Huzza Porpoise, being of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"a less rotund and jolly girth; indeed, he is of quite a neat and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"gentleman-like figure. But his mealy-mouth spoils all.  Though his entire","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"back down to his side fins is of a deep sable, yet a boundary line,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"distinct as the mark in a ship's hull, called the \"bright waist,\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"that line streaks him from stem to stern, with two separate colours,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"black above and white below. A most mean and mealy","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"aspect! But there are a rabble of uncertain, fugitive,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"half-fabulous whales, which, as an American whaleman, I know by","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"reputation, but not personally.  I shall enumerate them by their","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"fore-castle appellations; for possibly such a list may be valuable to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"future investigators, who may complete what I have here but begun.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"If any of the following whales, shall hereafter be caught and marked,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"then he can readily be incorporated into this System, according to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"his Folio, Octavo, or Duodecimo magnitude:--The Bottle-Nose Whale;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"the Junk Whale; the Pudding-Headed Whale; the Cape Whale; the Leading","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"Whale; the Cannon Whale; the Scragg Whale; the Coppered Whale; the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"Elephant Whale; the Iceberg Whale; the Quog Whale; the Blue Whale; etc.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"From Icelandic, Dutch, and old English authorities, there might","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"be quoted other lists of uncertain whales, blessed with all manner of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"uncouth names.  But I omit them as altogether obsolete; and can","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"hardly help suspecting them for mere sounds, full of Leviathanism,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"but signifying nothing.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"Finally: It was stated at the outset, that this system would not be","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"here, and at once, perfected.  You cannot but plainly see that I have","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"kept my word.  But I now leave my cetological System standing thus","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"unfinished, even as the great Cathedral of Cologne was left, with the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"crane still standing upon the top of the uncompleted tower.  For","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"small erections may be finished by their first architects; grand","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"ones, true ones, ever leave the copestone to posterity. The sum is, that at particular seasons within that breadth and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"along that path, migrating whales may with great confidence be looked","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"for.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"And hence not only at substantiated times, upon well known separate","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"feeding-grounds, could Ahab hope to encounter his prey; but in","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"crossing the widest expanses of water between those grounds he could,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"by his art, so place and time himself on his way, as even then not to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"be wholly without prospect of a meeting.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"There was a circumstance which at first sight seemed to entangle his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"delirious but still methodical scheme. So,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"too, with some other feeding grounds, where he had at times revealed","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:47","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:47Z","log":"himself. But in pursuit of those far mysteries we","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"dream of, or in tormented chase of that demon phantom that, some time","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"or other, swims before all human hearts; while chasing such over this","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"round globe, they either lead us on in barren mazes or midway leave","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"us whelmed.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"CHAPTER 53","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"The Gam.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"The ostensible reason why Ahab did not go on board of the whaler we","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"had spoken was this: the wind and sea betokened storms.  But even had","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"this not been the case, he would not after all, perhaps, have boarded","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"her--judging by his subsequent conduct on similar occasions--if so it","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"had been that, by the process of hailing, he had obtained a negative","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"answer to the question he put.  For, as it eventually turned out, he","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"cared not to consort, even for five minutes, with any stranger","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"captain, except he could contribute some of that information he so","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"absorbingly sought.  But all this might remain inadequately","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"estimated, were not something said here of the peculiar usages of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"whaling-vessels when meeting each other in foreign seas, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"especially on a common cruising-ground.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"If two strangers crossing the Pine Barrens in New York State, or the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"equally desolate Salisbury Plain in England; if casually encountering","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"each other in such inhospitable wilds, these twain, for the life of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"them, cannot well avoid a mutual salutation; and stopping for a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"moment to interchange the news; and, perhaps, sitting down for a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"while and resting in concert: then, how much more natural that upon","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"the illimitable Pine Barrens and Salisbury Plains of the sea, two","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"whaling vessels descrying each other at the ends of the earth--off","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"lone Fanning's Island, or the far away King's Mills; how much more","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"natural, I say, that under such circumstances these ships should not","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"only interchange hails, but come into still closer, more friendly and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"sociable contact.  And especially would this seem to be a matter of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"course, in the case of vessels owned in one seaport, and whose","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"captains, officers, and not a few of the men are personally known to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"each other; and consequently, have all sorts of dear domestic things","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"to talk about.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"For the long absent ship, the outward-bounder, perhaps, has letters","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"on board; at any rate, she will be sure to let her have some papers","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"of a date a year or two later than the last one on her blurred and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"thumb-worn files.  And in return for that courtesy, the outward-bound","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"ship would receive the latest whaling intelligence from the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"cruising-ground to which she may be destined, a thing of the utmost","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"importance to her.  And in degree, all this will hold true concerning","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"whaling vessels crossing each other's track on the cruising-ground","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"itself, even though they are equally long absent from home.  For one","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"of them may have received a transfer of letters from some third, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"now far remote vessel; and some of those letters may be for the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"people of the ship she now meets.  Besides, they would exchange the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"whaling news, and have an agreeable chat.  For not only would they","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"meet with all the sympathies of sailors, but likewise with all the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"peculiar congenialities arising from a common pursuit and mutually","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"shared privations and perils.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"Nor would difference of country make any very essential difference;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"that is, so long as both parties speak one language, as is the case","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"with Americans and English.  Though, to be sure, from the small","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"number of English whalers, such meetings do not very often occur, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"when they do occur there is too apt to be a sort of shyness between","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"them; for your Englishman is rather reserved, and your Yankee, he","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"does not fancy that sort of thing in anybody but himself.  Besides,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"the English whalers sometimes affect a kind of metropolitan","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"superiority over the American whalers; regarding the long, lean","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"Nantucketer, with his nondescript provincialisms, as a sort of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"sea-peasant.  But where this superiority in the English whalemen","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"does really consist, it would be hard to say, seeing that the Yankees","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"in one day, collectively, kill more whales than all the English,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"collectively, in ten years.  But this is a harmless little foible in","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"the English whale-hunters, which the Nantucketer does not take much","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"to heart; probably, because he knows that he has a few foibles","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"himself.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"So, then, we see that of all ships separately sailing the sea, the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"whalers have most reason to be sociable--and they are so.  Whereas,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"some merchant ships crossing each other's wake in the mid-Atlantic,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"will oftentimes pass on without so much as a single word of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"recognition, mutually cutting each other on the high seas, like a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"brace of dandies in Broadway; and all the time indulging, perhaps, in","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"finical criticism upon each other's rig.  As for Men-of-War, when","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"they chance to meet at sea, they first go through such a string of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"silly bowings and scrapings, such a ducking of ensigns, that there","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"does not seem to be much right-down hearty good-will and brotherly","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"love about it at all.  As touching Slave-ships meeting, why, they are","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"in such a prodigious hurry, they run away from each other as soon as","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"possible.  And as for Pirates, when they chance to cross each other's","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"cross-bones, the first hail is--\"How many skulls?\"--the same way that","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"whalers hail--\"How many barrels?\"  And that question once answered,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"pirates straightway steer apart, for they are infernal villains on","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"both sides, and don't like to see overmuch of each other's villanous","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"likenesses.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"But look at the godly, honest, unostentatious, hospitable, sociable,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"free-and-easy whaler!  What does the whaler do when she meets another","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"whaler in any sort of decent weather?  She has a \"GAM,\" a thing so","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"utterly unknown to all other ships that they never heard of the name","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"even; and if by chance they should hear of it, they only grin at it,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"and repeat gamesome stuff about \"spouters\" and \"blubber-boilers,\" and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"such like pretty exclamations.  Why it is that all Merchant-seamen,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"and also all Pirates and Man-of-War's men, and Slave-ship sailors,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"cherish such a scornful feeling towards Whale-ships; this is a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"question it would be hard to answer.  Because, in the case of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"pirates, say, I should like to know whether that profession of theirs","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"has any peculiar glory about it. And besides, when a man","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"is elevated in that odd fashion, he has no proper foundation for his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:48","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:48Z","log":"superior altitude. Tell me that, Mr. Flask?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"\"How old do you suppose Fedallah is, Stubb?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"\"Do you see that mainmast there?\" pointing to the ship; \"well, that's","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"the figure one; now take all the hoops in the Pequod's hold, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"string along in a row with that mast, for oughts, do you see; well,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"that wouldn't begin to be Fedallah's age.  Nor all the coopers in","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"creation couldn't show hoops enough to make oughts enough.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"\"But see here, Stubb, I thought you a little boasted just now, that","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"you meant to give Fedallah a sea-toss, if you got a good chance.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"Now, if he's so old as all those hoops of yours come to, and if he is","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"going to live for ever, what good will it do to pitch him","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"overboard--tell me that?","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"\"Give him a good ducking, anyhow.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"\"But he'd crawl back.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"\"Duck him again; But","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"though boats have been taken down and lost in this way, yet it is","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"this \"holding on,\" as it is called; this hooking up by the sharp","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"barbs of his live flesh from the back; this it is that often torments","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"the Leviathan into soon rising again to meet the sharp lance of his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"foes. Who can tell how appalling to the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"wounded whale must have been such huge phantoms flitting over his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"head!","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"\"Stand by, men; he stirs,\" cried Starbuck, as the three lines","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"suddenly vibrated in the water, distinctly conducting upwards to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"them, as by magnetic wires, the life and death throbs of the whale,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"so that every oarsman felt them in his seat. But when the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"swift Pequod, with a fresh leading wind, was herself in hot chase;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"how very kind of these tawny philanthropists to assist in speeding","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"her on to her own chosen pursuit,--mere riding-whips and rowels to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"her, that they were.  As with glass under arm, Ahab to-and-fro paced","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"the deck; in his forward turn beholding the monsters he chased, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"in the after one the bloodthirsty pirates chasing him; some such","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"fancy as the above seemed his. and not only that, but a herd of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"remorseless wild pirates and inhuman atheistical devils were","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"infernally cheering him on with their curses;--when all these","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"conceits had passed through his brain, Ahab's brow was left gaunt and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"ribbed, like the black sand beach after some stormy tide has been","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"gnawing it, without being able to drag the firm thing from its place.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"But thoughts like these troubled very few of the reckless crew; and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"when, after steadily dropping and dropping the pirates astern, the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"Pequod at last shot by the vivid green Cockatoo Point on the Sumatra","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"side, emerging at last upon the broad waters beyond; then, the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"harpooneers seemed more to grieve that the swift whales had been","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"gaining upon the ship, than to rejoice that the ship had so","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"victoriously gained upon the Malays.  But still driving on in the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"wake of the whales, at length they seemed abating their speed;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"gradually the ship neared them; and the wind now dying away, word was","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"passed to spring to the boats.  But no sooner did the herd, by some","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"presumed wonderful instinct of the Sperm Whale, become notified of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"the three keels that were after them,--though as yet a mile in their","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"rear,--than they rallied again, and forming in close ranks and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"battalions, so that their spouts all looked like flashing lines
