to our shirts and drawers, we sprang to the white-ash, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"after several hours' pulling were almost disposed to renounce the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"chase, when a general pausing commotion among the whales gave","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"animating token that they were now at last under the influence of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"that strange perplexity of inert irresolution, which, when the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"fishermen perceive it in the whale, they say he is gallied.  The","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"compact martial columns in which they had been hitherto rapidly and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"steadily swimming, were now broken up in one measureless rout; and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"like King Porus' elephants in the Indian battle with Alexander, they","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"seemed going mad with consternation.  In all directions expanding in","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"vast irregular circles, and aimlessly swimming hither and thither, by","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"their short thick spoutings, they plainly betrayed their distraction","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"of panic.  This was still more strangely evinced by those of their","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"number, who, completely paralysed as it were, helplessly floated like","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"water-logged dismantled ships on the sea.  Had these Leviathans been","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"but a flock of simple sheep, pursued over the pasture by three fierce","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"wolves, they could not possibly have evinced such excessive dismay.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"But this occasional timidity is characteristic of almost all herding","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"creatures.  Though banding together in tens of thousands, the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"lion-maned buffaloes of the West have fled before a solitary","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"horseman.  Witness, too, all human beings, how when herded together","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"in the sheepfold of a theatre's pit, they will, at the slightest","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"alarm of fire, rush helter-skelter for the outlets, crowding,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"trampling, jamming, and remorselessly dashing each other to death.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"Best, therefore, withhold any amazement at the strangely gallied","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"whales before us, for there is no folly of the beasts of the earth","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"which is not infinitely outdone by the madness of men.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"Though many of the whales, as has been said, were in violent motion,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"yet it is to be observed that as a whole the herd neither advanced","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"nor retreated, but collectively remained in one place.  As is","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"customary in those cases, the boats at once separated, each making","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"for some one lone whale on the outskirts of the shoal.  In about","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"three minutes' time, Queequeg's harpoon was flung; the stricken fish","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"darted blinding spray in our faces, and then running away with us like","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"light, steered straight for the heart of the herd.  Though such a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"movement on the part of the whale struck under such circumstances, is","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"in no wise unprecedented; and indeed is almost always more or less","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"anticipated; yet does it present one of the more perilous","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"vicissitudes of the fishery.  For as the swift monster drags you","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"deeper and deeper into the frantic shoal, you bid adieu to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"circumspect life and only exist in a delirious throb.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"As, blind and deaf, the whale plunged forward, as if by sheer power","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"of speed to rid himself of the iron leech that had fastened to him;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"as we thus tore a white gash in the sea, on all sides menaced as we","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"flew, by the crazed creatures to and fro rushing about us; our beset","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"boat was like a ship mobbed by ice-isles in a tempest, and striving","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"to steer through their complicated channels and straits, knowing not at","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"what moment it may be locked in and crushed.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"But not a bit daunted, Queequeg steered us manfully; now sheering off","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"from this monster directly across our route in advance; now edging","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"away from that, whose colossal flukes were suspended overhead, while","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"all the time, Starbuck stood up in the bows, lance in hand, pricking","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"out of our way whatever whales he could reach by short darts, for","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"there was no time to make long ones.  Nor were the oarsmen quite","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"idle, though their wonted duty was now altogether dispensed with.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"They chiefly attended to the shouting part of the business.  \"Out of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"the way, Commodore!\" cried one, to a great dromedary that of a sudden","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"rose bodily to the surface, and for an instant threatened to swamp","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"us.  \"Hard down with your tail, there!\" cried a second to another,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"which, close to our gunwale, seemed calmly cooling himself with his","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"own fan-like extremity.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"All whaleboats carry certain curious contrivances, originally","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"invented by the Nantucket Indians, called druggs.  Two thick squares","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"of wood of equal size are stoutly clenched together, so that they","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"cross each other's grain at right angles; a line of considerable","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"length is then attached to the middle of this block, and the other","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"end of the line being looped, it can in a moment be fastened to a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"harpoon.  It is chiefly among gallied whales that this drugg is used.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"For then, more whales are close round you than you can possibly","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"chase at one time.  But sperm whales are not every day encountered;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"while you may, then, you must kill all you can.  And if you cannot","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"kill them all at once, you must wing them, so that they can be","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"afterwards killed at your leisure.  Hence it is, that at times like","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"these the drugg, comes into requisition.  Our boat was furnished with","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"three of them.  The first and second were successfully darted, and we","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"saw the whales staggeringly running off, fettered by the enormous","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"sidelong resistance of the towing drugg.  They were cramped like","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:49","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:49Z","log":"malefactors with the chain and ball. But it was no use--I did all I could;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"sat up with him nights; was very severe with him in the matter of","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"diet--\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"Oh, very severe!\" chimed in the patient himself; then suddenly","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"altering his voice, \"Drinking hot rum toddies with me every night,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"till he couldn't see to put on the bandages; and sending me to bed,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"half seas over, about three o'clock in the morning. Oh! a great","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"watcher, and very dietetically severe, is Dr. Bunger. But, heave ahead, boy, I'd rather be killed by you than kept","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"alive by any other man.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"My captain, you must have ere this perceived, respected sir\"--said","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"the imperturbable godly-looking Bunger, slightly bowing to Ahab--\"is","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"apt to be facetious at times; he spins us many clever things of that","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"sort.  But I may as well say--en passant, as the French remark--that","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"I myself--that is to say, Jack Bunger, late of the reverend","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"clergy--am a strict total abstinence man; I never drink--\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"Water!\" cried the captain; but go on--go on","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"with the arm story.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"Yes, I may as well,\" said the surgeon, coolly.  \"I was about","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"observing, sir, before Captain Boomer's facetious interruption, that","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"spite of my best and severest endeavors, the wound kept getting worse","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"and worse; the truth was, sir, it was as ugly gaping wound as surgeon","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"ever saw; more than two feet and several inches long. In short, it grew black; I knew what was","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"threatened, and off it came.  But I had no hand in shipping that","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"ivory arm there; that thing is against all rule\"--pointing at it with","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"the marlingspike--\"that is the captain's work, not mine; he ordered","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"the carpenter to make it; he had that club-hammer there put to the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"end, to knock some one's brains out with, I suppose, as he tried mine","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"once.  He flies into diabolical passions sometimes.  Do ye see this","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"dent, sir\"--removing his hat, and brushing aside his hair, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"exposing a bowl-like cavity in his skull, but which bore not the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"slightest scarry trace, or any token of ever having been a","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"wound--\"Well, the captain there will tell you how that came here;","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"he knows.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"No, I don't,\" said the captain, \"but his mother did; he was born","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"with it.  Oh, you solemn rogue, you--you Bunger! was there ever such","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"another Bunger in the watery world?  Bunger, when you die, you ought","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"to die in pickle, you dog; you should be preserved to future ages,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"you rascal.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"What became of the White Whale?\" now cried Ahab, who thus far had","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"been impatiently listening to this by-play between the two","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"Englishmen.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"Oh!\" cried the one-armed captain, \"oh, yes!  Well; after he sounded,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"we didn't see him again for some time; in fact, as I before hinted, I","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"didn't then know what whale it was that had served me such a trick,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"till some time afterwards, when coming back to the Line, we heard","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"about Moby Dick--as some call him--and then I knew it was he.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"Did'st thou cross his wake again?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"Twice.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"But could not fasten?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"Didn't want to try to: ain't one limb enough?  What should I do","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"without this other arm?  And I'm thinking Moby Dick doesn't bite so","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"much as he swallows.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"Well, then,\" interrupted Bunger, \"give him your left arm for bait to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"get the right.  Do you know, gentlemen\"--very gravely and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"mathematically bowing to each Captain in succession--\"Do you know,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"gentlemen, that the digestive organs of the whale are so inscrutably","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"constructed by Divine Providence, that it is quite impossible for him","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"to completely digest even a man's arm?  And he knows it too.  So that","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"what you take for the White Whale's malice is only his awkwardness.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"For he never means to swallow a single limb; he only thinks to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"terrify by feints. No possible","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"way for him to digest that jack-knife, and fully incorporate it into","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"his general bodily system.  Yes, Captain Boomer, if you are quick","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"enough about it, and have a mind to pawn one arm for the sake of the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"privilege of giving decent burial to the other, why in that case","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"the arm is yours; only let the whale have another chance at you","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"shortly, that's all.\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"No, thank ye, Bunger,\" said the English Captain, \"he's welcome to","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"the arm he has, since I can't help it, and didn't know him then; but","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"not to another one.  No more White Whales for me; I've lowered for","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"him once, and that has satisfied me.  There would be great glory in","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"killing him, I know that; and there is a ship-load of precious sperm","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"in him, but, hark ye, he's best let alone; don't you think so,","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"Captain?\"--glancing at the ivory leg.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"He is.  But he will still be hunted, for all that.  What is best let","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"alone, that accursed thing is not always what least allures.  He's","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"all a magnet!  How long since thou saw'st him last?  Which way","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"heading?\"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"Bless my soul, and curse the foul fiend's,\" cried Bunger, stoopingly","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"walking round Ahab, and like a dog, strangely snuffing; \"this man's","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"blood--bring the thermometer!--it's at the boiling point!--his pulse","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"makes these planks beat!--sir!\"--taking a lancet from his pocket, and","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"drawing near to Ahab's arm.","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"\"Avast!\" roared Ahab, dashing him against the bulwarks--\"Man the","level":"NORMAL","stepctx":"1","node":"xubuntu"},{"time":"13:49:50","absolute_time":"2020-04-30T18:49:50Z","log":"boat!
